headline: Sep 15 PM · A late edition after the brief itself went quiet — the Sep 15 AM run never completed, so this is the first published brief since Sep 14 PM and it carries the day. The two instruments that can speak said the same thing again: the Sep 14 and Sep 15 digests both landed on time and are digit-for-digit identical, making it the seventh straight identical day. The two that should speak stayed silent longer — FA-ADS watchdog dark ~124h, Meta→CRM spend-sync ~103h with no success notice ever. Mary Grossman's callback is four days past with nothing written on the record; compliance 0/7 on day 19; one real NV lead still behind the gate.
source: index.html · ORAYA DATA block v15.20 + live Gmail sweep through Sep 15 20:52Z (Sep 14 digest 15:00:06Z + Sep 15 digest 15:00:09Z, both identical; no SYNC FAILED/success since Sep 11 13:32Z; no watchdog run since Sep 10 17:06Z; no lead/founder mail; new non-funnel: Supabase security alert, Spacemail expiry, Accugene Workspace setup). spotlight.title: Mary Grossman — four days past, close it in writing
spotlight.detail: The Fri 6:45 PM PT callback is now four days gone, and Monday's live business-day window passed with nothing written. Three consecutive digests (Sep 13, 14, 15) put the miss on the system of record — 0 booked, 3 unbooked, 3 SLA breached. First real $300-Plan lead (NV), NO TCPA consent → hand-dial only +1 805 302 2655. Eighth ask: one sentence in a lane — called / referred / held. It stays on the record until a human writes it.

spotlight.title: Open the CRM — the one look that settles two dead instruments
spotlight.detail: Seven identical digests (Sep 9→15) mean the scoreboard can no longer tell 'nothing happened' from 'reading a frozen table.' One minute in the CRM answers both open unknowns regardless of what the digest prints: (a) are there ad-spend rows stamped after Sep 11 13:32Z — w30, the sync question; (b) do the lead rows really show 3 with contact / 3 unbooked / 3 breached, or has the table not been written since Sep 9. Write the two answers into the board; do not infer either from silence.

spotlight.title: Day 19, 0/7 compliance, and the paid motion is running blind ~124h
spotlight.detail: Consumer flow went live Aug 27; nineteen days later none of the seven blockers is closed — b3 (TX telephone-solicitor registration) and b7 (CA producer license #) are the two that gate the lead in hand. The FA-ADS watchdog has not run since Sep 10 17:06Z (~124h), so V2 spend (last read ~$72 of the $200 tranche) has had no reader for over five days. State the paid motion plainly — keep spending or hold — or restore what the watchdog runs on. Letting it drain by default is the one choice the board cannot accept.
